Which of the following approaches most closely reflects the strategy actually deployed by Gandhi and Congress to achieve this mobilization?

(a) Emphasizing the economic benefits that would accrue to the family if colonial salt taxes were abolished, making the political cause a domestic economic concern
(b) Framing women's participation as an expression of their innate domestic virtues — motherhood, sacrifice, and endurance — so that public protest became an extension of, rather than a departure from, their existing cultural roles
(c) Appealing to women's sense of international solidarity by showing them reports of women's movements in Britain and America, demonstrating that globally progressive women participated in public life
(d) Presenting women's participation as a legal right that colonial law had suppressed, arguing that claiming this right was a civic duty that transcended cultural tradition
en.strong_distractor: d — Option (d) is a strong distractor because appealing to legal rights sounds like a straightforward mobilization strategy and connects to CDM's goal of challenging colonial law — students who think in terms of rights discourse may find this the most logical answer.
elimination_logic: The scenario describes a mobilization approach targeting women from conservative, purdah-observing, upper-caste families — making public protest 'culturally safe' was the key challenge.

Eliminate (a): Emphasizing economic benefits does not address the cultural acceptability problem for purdah-observing families; economic framing was not Gandhi's primary rhetorical tool for this audience.
Eliminate (c): International solidarity appeals were not the mechanism Gandhi used for conservative domestic audiences — this was more relevant to the international propaganda dimension.
Eliminate (d): Legal rights discourse was the least likely to work for conservative families who defined women's sphere in cultural/domestic terms, not legal ones.

Confirm (b): Gandhi's 'shakti' framework — framing women's satyagraha as an extension of their natural domestic virtues (motherhood, sacrifice, purity) — was precisely designed to make public protest culturally acceptable for conservative audiences.
en.upsc_trap_explanation: Option (d) is a partial-truth distractor because CDM was indeed about challenging colonial law, and legal rights were part of the nationalist discourse. However, Gandhi's specific strategy for drawing conservative, purdah-observing women into public protest was not legal rights discourse — which would have been culturally alien and threatening to conservative families — but the 'shakti' and motherhood framing that mapped women's political participation onto existing cultural values of sacrifice and domestic virtue. A student thinking about the CDM's goals (challenging colonial law) rather than its specific mobilization strategy for conservative women will choose (d).
en.final_explanation:
This scenario describes one of the CDM's most strategically sophisticated challenges: mobilizing women from conservative, purdah-observing households without triggering cultural resistance from families that defined women's proper sphere as domestic.

Gandhi's solution was the 'shakti' and motherhood framework: presenting women's participation in the CDM not as a break with their domestic roles but as the highest expression of those roles — a mother's courage in defending her family's nation, a woman's innate capacity for suffering deployed in service of truth. This framing made public protest culturally intelligible and acceptable to audiences for whom feminist rights discourse would have been alienating.

• Option (a): Incorrect. Economic benefit framing does not address the cultural-domestic barrier for purdah-observing families.
• Option (b): Correct. The 'shakti'/motherhood framework — mapping protest onto domestic virtue — was Gandhi's specific rhetorical strategy for conservative audiences.
• Option (c): Incorrect. International solidarity was relevant to the CDM's global propaganda but not to domestic conservative mobilization.
• Option (d): Incorrect. Legal rights discourse was the least culturally resonant approach for families that defined women's sphere in traditional rather than legal terms.

Value Addition:
• The 'shakti' framework's dual nature — empowering in tone, potentially role-reinforcing in content — is the central tension in feminist scholarly critique of Gandhi's gender politics.
• This mobilization strategy was remarkably effective: women from families that had never allowed public activism participated in the CDM precisely because it was framed as an extension of domestic duty.
• The same tension — using traditional gender frameworks to achieve progressive mobilization — appears in multiple historical contexts and is a productive Mains analytical lens.

सिविल अवज्ञा आंदोलन के दौरान, एक कांग्रेस आयोजक गुजरात के एक छोटे से शहर में रूढ़िवादी, पर्दा-पालन करने वाले, उच्च जाति के परिवारों की महिलाओं को सार्वजनिक विरोध गतिविधियों में भाग लेने के लिए मनाने की कोशिश कर रहा है। परिवार राष्ट्रवादी कारण के खिलाफ नहीं हैं, लेकिन वे महिलाओं की सार्वजनिक जुलूसों में भागीदारी को सांस्कृतिक रूप से अनुचित और संभावित रूप से अपमानजनक मानते हैं। आयोजक को एक ऐसा वक्तृत्व ढांचा चाहिए जो परिवारों को उनके मौजूदा लिंग मूल्यों को त्यागे बिना भागीदारी को सांस्कृतिक रूप से स्वीकार्य बना सके।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा दृष्टिकोण गांधी और कांग्रेस द्वारा इस जनसंचालन को प्राप्त करने के लिए वास्तव में अपनाई गई रणनीति के सबसे निकट है?

elimination_logic: परिदृश्य एक जनसंचालन दृष्टिकोण का वर्णन करता है जो रूढ़िवादी, पर्दा-पालन करने वाले, उच्च जाति के परिवारों की महिलाओं को लक्षित करता है — सार्वजनिक विरोध को 'सांस्कृतिक रूप से सुरक्षित' बनाना मुख्य चुनौती थी।

(a) को निरस्त करें — आर्थिक लाभ पर जोर देना पर्दा-पालन करने वाले परिवारों के लिए सांस्कृतिक स्वीकार्यता की समस्या का समाधान नहीं करता; आर्थिक फ्रेमिंग गांधी का इस दर्शक वर्ग के लिए मुख्य वक्तृत्व उपकरण नहीं था।
(c) को निरस्त करें — अंतरराष्ट्रीय एकजुटता की अपील गांधी ने रूढ़िवादी घरेलू दर्शकों के लिए उपयोग नहीं की — यह अधिकतर अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रचार के लिए प्रासंगिक थी।
(d) को निरस्त करें — कानूनी अधिकारों का विमर्श उन रूढ़िवादी परिवारों के लिए सबसे कम प्रभावी था जो महिलाओं के क्षेत्र को सांस्कृतिक/घरेलू संदर्भों में परिभाषित करते थे, न कि कानूनी।

(b) को स्वीकार करें — गांधी का 'शक्ति' फ्रेमवर्क — महिलाओं के सत्याग्रह को उनके प्राकृतिक घरेलू सदाचारों (मातृत्व, त्याग, पवित्रता) का विस्तार मानना — सार्वजनिक विरोध को रूढ़िवादी दर्शकों के लिए सांस्कृतिक रूप से स्वीकार्य बनाने के लिए विशेष रूप से डिज़ाइन किया गया था।
hi.upsc_trap_explanation: विकल्प (d) एक आंशिक-सत्य भ्रमकारी है क्योंकि CDM वास्तव में उपनिवेशी कानून को चुनौती देने के बारे में था, और कानूनी अधिकार राष्ट्रवादी विमर्श का हिस्सा थे। हालांकि, रूढ़िवादी, पर्दा-पालन करने वाली महिलाओं को सार्वजनिक विरोध में शामिल करने के लिए गांधी की विशिष्ट रणनीति कानूनी अधिकारों का विमर्श नहीं थी — जो सांस्कृतिक रूप से विदेशी और रूढ़िवादी परिवारों के लिए खतरा था — बल्कि 'शक्ति' और मातृत्व फ्रेमिंग थी जो महिलाओं की राजनीतिक भागीदारी को त्याग और घरेलू सदाचार के मौजूदा सांस्कृतिक मूल्यों से जोड़ती थी। जो छात्र CDM के लक्ष्यों (उपनिवेशी कानून को चुनौती देना) के बजाय इसकी विशिष्ट जनसंचालन रणनीति के बारे में सोचते हैं, वे (d) चुनेंगे।
hi.final_explanation:
यह परिदृश्य CDM की सबसे रणनीतिक रूप से परिष्कृत चुनौतियों में से एक का वर्णन करता है: रूढ़िवादी, पर्दा-पालन करने वाले परिवारों की महिलाओं को जनसामान्य विरोध में जुटाना बिना उन परिवारों से सांस्कृतिक प्रतिरोध को उत्पन्न किए, जो महिलाओं के उचित क्षेत्र को घरेलू मानते थे।

गांधी का समाधान था 'शक्ति' और मातृत्व फ्रेमवर्क: महिलाओं की भागीदारी को उनके घरेलू कर्तव्यों से अलगाव के रूप में नहीं बल्कि उन कर्तव्यों की सर्वोच्च अभिव्यक्ति के रूप में प्रस्तुत करना — एक माँ का साहस अपने परिवार के राष्ट्र की रक्षा में, एक महिला की सत्य की सेवा में सहने की स्वाभाविक क्षमता। इस फ्रेमिंग ने सार्वजनिक विरोध को उन दर्शकों के लिए सांस्कृतिक रूप से समझने योग्य और स्वीकार्य बना दिया, जिनके लिए नारीवादी अधिकारों का विमर्श विदेशी होता।

• विकल्प (a): गलत। आर्थिक लाभ फ्रेमिंग पर्दा-पालन करने वाले परिवारों के लिए सांस्कृतिक-घरेलू बाधा को संबोधित नहीं करती।
• विकल्प (b): सही। 'शक्ति'/मातृत्व फ्रेमवर्क — विरोध को घरेलू सदाचार से जोड़ना — गांधी की रूढ़िवादी दर्शकों के लिए विशिष्ट वक्तृत्व रणनीति थी।
• विकल्प (c): गलत। अंतरराष्ट्रीय एकजुटता CDM के वैश्विक प्रचार के लिए प्रासंगिक थी, घरेलू रूढ़िवादी जनसंचालन के लिए नहीं।
• विकल्प (d): गलत। कानूनी अधिकारों का विमर्श उन परिवारों के लिए सबसे कम सांस्कृतिक रूप से प्रभावी था जो महिलाओं के क्षेत्र को पारंपरिक न कि कानूनी संदर्भों में परिभाषित करते थे।

मूल्य संवर्धन:
• 'शक्ति' फ्रेमवर्क की द्वैत प्रकृति — स्वर में सशक्तिकरण, सामग्री में संभावित भूमिका-पुष्टि — गांधी की लिंग राजनीति पर नारीवादी विद्वानों की आलोचना का केंद्रीय तनाव है।
• यह जनसंचालन रणनीति अत्यंत प्रभावी थी: उन परिवारों की महिलाएं जो कभी सार्वजनिक सक्रियता की अनुमति नहीं देती थीं, CDM में इसलिए शामिल हुईं क्योंकि इसे घरेलू कर्तव्य का विस्तार माना गया।
• यही तनाव — पारंपरिक लिंग फ्रेमवर्क का उपयोग प्रगतिशील जनसंचालन के लिए — कई ऐतिहासिक संदर्भों में दिखाई देता है और यह मेन्स परीक्षा के लिए एक उत्पादक विश्लेषणात्मक दृष्टिकोण है।

shared.concept_anchor: CDM historiography — media, memory, and class selectivity

en.display_text:
Consider the following statements about media construction and historical memory in relation to women's participation in the Civil Disobedience Movement:

1. Gandhi's press writings in 'Young India' selectively amplified the contributions of English-educated, upper-caste women while rendering the stories of Dalit and rural women participants largely invisible in the dominant CDM narrative.
2. The foreign press coverage of CDM women's participation focused exclusively on the non-violent suffering of women in high-profile incidents such as the Dharasana raid, ignoring all regional and rural women's resistance.
3. The construction of the 'nationalist woman' in CDM-era media represents a historiographical concern — the media's selection of which women's stories to amplify has shaped which participants are remembered and which are forgotten in historical consciousness.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?

(a) 1 and 3 only
(b) 2 and 3 only
(c) 1 and 2 only
(d) 1, 2 and 3

statement_analysis.statement: Gandhi's press writings in 'Young India' selectively amplified the contributions of English-educated, upper-caste women while rendering the stories of Dalit and rural women participants largely invisible in the dominant CDM narrative.
statement_analysis.reason: Gandhi's press writings consistently featured bhadramahila figures as the ideal nationalist woman, while anonymous lower-caste and rural women who performed salt manufacturing and supply chain work received minimal individual coverage.

statement_analysis.statement: The foreign press coverage of CDM women's participation focused exclusively on the non-violent suffering of women in high-profile incidents such as the Dharasana raid, ignoring all regional and rural women's resistance.
statement_analysis.reason: While foreign press did concentrate coverage on high-profile incidents like Dharasana, the claim of 'exclusively' and 'ignoring all regional' coverage is an absolute overstatement — some foreign correspondents did cover provincial CDM activities, though less prominently.

statement_analysis.statement: The construction of the 'nationalist woman' in CDM-era media represents a historiographical concern — the media's selection of which women's stories to amplify has shaped which participants are remembered and which are forgotten in historical consciousness.
statement_analysis.reason: The relationship between CDM-era media amplification and historical memory survival is a documented feminist historiographical point — the categories of women whose stories entered the dominant nationalist narrative are precisely those that press coverage privileged.

en.strong_distractor: d — Option (d) is a strong distractor because including Statement 2 (which sounds like a reasonable limitation of foreign press coverage) alongside the two correct statements makes option (d) tempting for students who do not identify the 'exclusively' qualifier as an overstatement.
elimination_logic: Evaluate Statement 1: Gandhi's press selectively amplified bhadramahila figures is a documented feminist historiographical position — correct.
Evaluate Statement 2: 'Exclusively... ignoring all regional coverage' is an absolute overstatement of foreign press selectivity; some regional coverage existed — incorrect.
Evaluate Statement 3: The media-memory link in CDM historiography is a well-established scholarly concern — correct.
Statements 1 and 3 correct, Statement 2 incorrect → option (a): '1 and 3 only'.
en.upsc_trap_explanation: Statement 2 uses a scope-extension trap with the absolute qualifiers 'exclusively' and 'ignoring all.' Students who know foreign press concentrated on high-profile incidents may accept this as a strong but accurate description of selectivity. The factual error is in the absolute claim — 'exclusively' and 'all' are never defensible as historical absolute claims in this context. Recognizing overstatement in absolute qualifiers is a critical UPSC analytical skill.
en.final_explanation:
CDM historiography increasingly focuses on the gap between historical participants and historical memory — a gap shaped by media choices made in 1930 and reflected in subsequent scholarship.

• Statement 1 — Correct: Gandhi's 'Young India' and Congress-aligned press systematically featured bhadramahila (educated, upper-caste urban women) as the ideal nationalist woman, while Dalit and rural women's contributions were not individually named or amplified. This media pattern directly shaped which women's stories entered historical memory.
• Statement 2 — Incorrect: The claim that foreign press coverage focused 'exclusively' on high-profile incidents and ignored 'all' regional resistance is an absolute overstatement. Foreign correspondents did concentrate on dramatic incidents like Dharasana, but some provincial CDM activities received coverage. The qualifiers 'exclusively' and 'all' render Statement 2 false.
• Statement 3 — Correct: The media-memory construction critique is a central concern in feminist historiography of the CDM — it explains why recovery of rural and Dalit women's contributions requires non-standard sources like oral history and regional archives.

Value Addition:
• This historiographical perspective is increasingly relevant to UPSC Mains Essay questions on 'writing history from below' or 'subaltern perspectives.'
• The phrase 'whose stories survive in the historical record' is a useful Mains framing for critiquing the CDM's claim to being a genuinely mass women's movement.
• Gandhi's 'Harijan' (published from 1933) continued the pattern of selective amplification of certain ideal nationalist figures while discussing untouchability — the same selectivity applied to gender.

Consider the following statements about the organizational dimensions of women's participation in the nationalist movements:

Statement 1: The significantly larger scale and organizational depth of women's participation in the CDM compared to the Non-Cooperation Movement was primarily a consequence of Gandhi's explicit and direct call to women in 1930, which was qualitatively different from the implicit inclusion in 1920.

Statement 2: The formation of organized women's volunteer bodies such as the Desh Sewika Sangh during the CDM demonstrates that women's organizational capacity in the nationalist movement was higher in the NCM than in the CDM, since such specialized bodies had not been necessary in 1920.

Which of the following is correct?

(a) Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are correct
(b) Both Statement 1 and Statement 2 are incorrect
(c) Statement 1 is correct but Statement 2 is incorrect
(d) Statement 1 is incorrect but Statement 2 is correct

statement_analysis.statement: The significantly larger scale and organizational depth of women's participation in the CDM compared to the Non-Cooperation Movement was primarily a consequence of Gandhi's explicit and direct call to women in 1930, which was qualitatively different from the implicit inclusion in 1920.
statement_analysis.reason: Historians specifically attribute the CDM's greater organizational depth of women's participation to Gandhi's 1930 explicit invitation — a structural cause that differs from the NCM's implicit, generalized mobilization call.

statement_analysis.statement: The formation of organized women's volunteer bodies such as the Desh Sewika Sangh during the CDM demonstrates that women's organizational capacity in the nationalist movement was higher in the NCM than in the CDM, since such specialized bodies had not been necessary in 1920.
statement_analysis.reason: The formation of the Desh Sewika Sangh demonstrates the opposite — greater organizational sophistication in the CDM compared to the NCM. More specialized organizational forms indicate greater, not lesser, organizational capacity.

en.strong_distractor: a — Option (a) is a strong distractor because students who correctly identify Statement 1 as true may accept Statement 2's logic (absence of specialized bodies in 1920 being reframed as NCM having 'sufficient' existing organizational capacity) without questioning the reversed-causation embedded in Statement 2.
elimination_logic: Evaluate Statement 1: Gandhi's explicit 1930 call as the structural cause of CDM's greater women's organizational depth is the established historiographical explanation — Statement 1 is correct.

Evaluate Statement 2: The Desh Sewika Sangh's formation demonstrates CDM's greater organizational sophistication, not NCM's superior capacity — Statement 2 inverts the causal logic, making it incorrect.
Statement 1 correct + Statement 2 incorrect → option (c): Statement 1 is correct but Statement 2 is incorrect.
en.upsc_trap_explanation: Statement 2 embeds a reversed-causation trap: the argument that the absence of specialized women's volunteer bodies in the NCM indicates NCM had 'sufficient' organizational capacity (and therefore higher capacity) is logically inverted. The correct interpretation is that the NCM's lack of such bodies reflects its lower organizational sophistication in mobilizing women — while the CDM's formation of dedicated women's volunteer units reflects its greater organizational capacity and deliberate structural investment in women's mobilization.
en.final_explanation:
The NCM-CDM comparison in women's participation is one of escalation and structural differentiation — not mere repetition at different scales.

• Statement 1 — Correct: Gandhi's explicit 1930 invitation to women (reversing his initial exclusion) is the structural cause historians cite for the CDM's significantly greater organizational depth in women's participation compared to the NCM's implicit general call in 1920.
• Statement 2 — Incorrect: The formation of specialized women's volunteer bodies (Desh Sewika Sangh, etc.) during the CDM demonstrates the CDM's greater — not lesser — organizational capacity. Specialized institutional structures indicate more sophisticated mobilization, not the absence of need. NCM's lack of equivalent bodies reflects lower organizational investment in women's mobilization, not superior existing capacity.

Value Addition:
• The NCM-CDM escalation pattern — from implicit inclusion and supporting roles to explicit invitation and frontline participation — is a key analytical frame for UPSC Mains comparative questions.
• The Desh Sewika Sangh's formation represents the institutionalization of women's nationalist activism — a development with both organizational and proto-feminist significance.
• Organizational sophistication in nationalist movements is often measured by the specificity and autonomy of their constituent bodies — a useful Mains analytical lens.

hi.final_explanation:
महिलाओं की भागीदारी में असहयोग आंदोलन और सहयोग आंदोलन की तुलना वृद्धि और संरचनात्मक भेद का उदाहरण है — केवल विभिन्न स्तरों पर पुनरावृत्ति नहीं।

• कथन 1 — सही: गांधीजी का 1930 में महिलाओं को दिया गया स्पष्ट निमंत्रण (जो उनके प्रारंभिक बहिष्कार को उलटता है) इतिहासकारों द्वारा सहयोग आंदोलन में महिलाओं की गहरी संगठनात्मक भागीदारी का संरचनात्मक कारण माना जाता है, जो 1920 के निहित सामान्य आह्वान से गुणात्मक रूप से भिन्न है।
• कथन 2 — गलत: सहयोग आंदोलन के दौरान विशेष महिला स्वयंसेवी निकायों (जैसे देश सेविका संघ) का गठन सहयोग आंदोलन की अधिक — न कि कम — संगठनात्मक क्षमता को दर्शाता है। विशेष संस्थागत संरचनाएं अधिक परिष्कृत आंदोलन को दर्शाती हैं, न कि आवश्यकता की अनुपस्थिति को। असहयोग आंदोलन में समकक्ष निकायों की कमी महिलाओं के आंदोलन में कम संगठनात्मक निवेश को दर्शाती है, न कि बेहतर मौजूदा क्षमता।

मूल्यवर्धन:
• असहयोग और सहयोग आंदोलन के बीच वृद्धि पैटर्न — निहित समावेशन और सहायक भूमिकाओं से स्पष्ट निमंत्रण और अग्रिम पंक्ति की भागीदारी तक — UPSC मेन्स के तुलनात्मक प्रश्नों के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक ढांचा है।
• देश सेविका संघ का गठन महिलाओं के राष्ट्रीय सक्रियता के संस्थागतकरण का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है — जो संगठनात्मक और प्रोटो-नारीवादी दोनों दृष्टिकोणों से महत्वपूर्ण है।
• राष्ट्रीय आंदोलनों में संगठनात्मक परिष्कारता अक्सर उनके घटक निकायों की विशिष्टता और स्वायत्तता से मापी जाती है — जो मेन्स के लिए उपयोगी विश्लेषणात्मक दृष्टिकोण है।

table_data.header_text: Consider the following statements about CDM-era women nationalists:
rows: Sarojini Naidu's role at Dharasana was primarily operational — she directed tactical decisions during the raid — rather than largely symbolic.

Kasturba Gandhi's mobilization work during the CDM was primarily through the Sabarmati Ashram network in Gujarat, where her status as Gandhi's wife served as a powerful legitimating force for women's participation.
Pritilata Waddedar's nationalist activities during the 1930–32 period were carried out within the framework of the Gandhian Civil Disobedience Movement as a frontline satyagrahi.

Bengal's women nationalists of the CDM period were predominantly associated with the revolutionary tradition rather than Gandhian non-violent resistance, representing a distinct ideological path from Gujarat's Gandhian women organizers.
table_data.footer_text:
How many of the above statements are correct?

(a) Only one
(b) Only two
(c) Only three
(d) All four

statement_analysis.statement: Sarojini Naidu's role at Dharasana was primarily operational — she directed tactical decisions during the raid — rather than largely symbolic.
statement_analysis.reason: Historians distinguish between Naidu's symbolic and figurehead role at Dharasana and the operational command, which was carried out by others; her primary significance was symbolic and propagandistic, not operational/tactical.

statement_analysis.statement: Kasturba Gandhi's mobilization work during the CDM was primarily through the Sabarmati Ashram network in Gujarat, where her status as Gandhi's wife served as a powerful legitimating force for women's participation.
statement_analysis.reason: This accurately characterizes both the geographic anchor (Gujarat, Sabarmati Ashram) and the mechanism (spousal legitimacy) of Kasturba's CDM contribution.

statement_analysis.statement: Pritilata Waddedar's nationalist activities during the 1930–32 period were carried out within the framework of the Gandhian Civil Disobedience Movement as a frontline satyagrahi.
statement_analysis.reason: Waddedar was a revolutionary nationalist who operated in the armed resistance tradition of Surya Sen's Chittagong group — she was explicitly outside the Gandhian CDM framework.

statement_analysis.statement: Bengal's women nationalists of the CDM period were predominantly associated with the revolutionary tradition rather than Gandhian non-violent resistance, representing a distinct ideological path from Gujarat's Gandhian women organizers.
statement_analysis.reason: The ideological split between Bengal's revolutionary women (Waddedar and her contemporaries) and Gujarat's Gandhian women organizers (Mithuben Petit, Kasturba) is historically documented.

en.strong_distractor: c — Option (c) is a strong distractor because students who know Naidu's Dharasana role (Statement 1) was significant and know Kasturba's Gujarat connection (Statement 2) may accept both as correct without scrutinizing whether Naidu's role was operational or symbolic.
elimination_logic: Evaluate Statement 1: Naidu's Dharasana role is historically characterized as symbolic/figurehead, not primarily operational — Statement 1 incorrectly calls it primarily operational — incorrect.
Evaluate Statement 2: Kasturba's Gujarat/Ashram-based mobilization and spousal legitimacy function is accurately characterized — correct.
Evaluate Statement 3: Waddedar was a revolutionary, not a CDM satyagrahi — Statement 3 is incorrect.
Evaluate Statement 4: Bengal's women nationalists being predominantly revolutionary vs. Gujarat's Gandhian organizers is accurately characterized — correct.
Two correct statements (2 and 4) → option (b): Only two.
en.upsc_trap_explanation: Statement 1's entity-swap is between Naidu's symbolic role and an operational/tactical one. Students who know Naidu 'led' the Dharasana raid may interpret 'led' as operational command, when historians specifically note she was a symbolic figurehead — the operational direction was carried out by others. The word 'primarily operational' in Statement 1 is the precise error. Statement 3 repeats the fundamental Waddedar-CDM conflation trap, which this question set has used to reinforce the critical distinction between revolutionary and Gandhian women's nationalism.
en.final_explanation:
Precise characterization of individual women's roles and the correct ideological categorization of their activism are tested here.

• Statement 1 — Incorrect: Naidu's role at Dharasana was symbolic and propagandistic — she provided figurehead leadership and moral authority, while operational decisions were carried out by others. Calling her role 'primarily operational' mischaracterizes the historical record.
• Statement 2 — Correct: Kasturba's CDM contribution was anchored in Gujarat through the Sabarmati Ashram network, and her spousal legitimacy — the 'wife of the Mahatma' effect — was the specific mechanism through which she expanded women's participation among conservative families.
• Statement 3 — Incorrect: Waddedar operated in the armed revolutionary tradition of Surya Sen's Chittagong group — she was contemporaneous with the CDM but not a participant in Gandhian civil disobedience.
• Statement 4 — Correct: The Bengal revolutionary / Gujarat Gandhian ideological split in women's nationalism is a documented historical contrast, reflecting Bengal's stronger tradition of armed anti-colonial resistance.

Value Addition:
• The symbolic-vs-operational distinction for Naidu at Dharasana is a nuance that distinguishes a deeply prepared answer from a superficially correct one in Mains.
• The Bengal-Gujarat contrast in women's nationalist ideology maps onto the broader revolutionary-Gandhian divide in the Indian freedom struggle.
• Knowing that 'led' in historical narratives may mean symbolic figurehead rather than tactical commander is a useful critical reading skill for primary source-based questions.

hi.upsc_trap_explanation: कथन 1 में नायडू की प्रतीकात्मक भूमिका और परिचालन/रणनीतिक भूमिका के बीच वस्तु-स्थानांतरण है। जो छात्र जानते हैं कि नायडू ने धरसाना छापे का नेतृत्व किया, वे 'नेतृत्व' को परिचालन कमान के रूप में समझ सकते हैं, जबकि इतिहासकार स्पष्ट रूप से कहते हैं कि वह प्रतीकात्मक मुखौटा थीं — परिचालन निर्देशन अन्य लोगों द्वारा किया गया था। कथन 1 में 'मुख्यतः परिचालनात्मक' शब्द त्रुटि है। कथन 3 में वड्डेदार-CDM मिश्रण की मूलभूत गलती दोहराई गई है, जो इस प्रश्न सेट ने क्रांतिकारी और गांधीवादी महिला राष्ट्रवाद के बीच महत्वपूर्ण भेद को मजबूत करने के लिए उपयोग किया है।

व्यक्तिगत महिलाओं की भूमिकाओं का सटीक वर्णन और उनके सक्रियता की सही वैचारिक श्रेणीकरण यहाँ परखा गया है।

• कथन 1 — गलत: धरसाना में नायडू की भूमिका प्रतीकात्मक और प्रचारात्मक थी — उन्होंने मुखौटा नेतृत्व और नैतिक अधिकार प्रदान किया, जबकि परिचालन निर्णय अन्य लोगों द्वारा लिए गए। उनकी भूमिका को 'मुख्यतः परिचालनात्मक' कहना ऐतिहासिक रिकॉर्ड का गलत चित्रण है।
• कथन 2 — सही: कस्तूरबा का CDM योगदान गुजरात के साबरमती आश्रम नेटवर्क के माध्यम से था, और उनकी वैवाहिक वैधता — 'महात्मा की पत्नी' प्रभाव — वह विशिष्ट तंत्र था जिससे उन्होंने रूढ़िवादी परिवारों में महिलाओं की भागीदारी बढ़ाई।
• कथन 3 — गलत: वड्डेदार सूर्य सेन के चिट्टागोंग समूह की सशस्त्र क्रांतिकारी परंपरा में काम करती थीं — वह CDM की गांधीवादी सविनय अवज्ञा आंदोलन की भागीदार नहीं थीं।
• कथन 4 — सही: बंगाल की क्रांतिकारी और गुजरात की गांधीवादी महिला राष्ट्रवादियों के बीच वैचारिक विभाजन ऐतिहासिक रूप से प्रलेखित है, जो बंगाल की सशस्त्र विरोध की मजबूत परंपरा को दर्शाता है।

मूल्यवर्धन:
• धरसाना में नायडू की प्रतीकात्मक बनाम परिचालनात्मक भूमिका का भेद एक सूक्ष्मता है जो मेन्स में सतही सही उत्तर से गहराई से तैयार उत्तर को अलग करता है।
• महिला राष्ट्रवाद में बंगाल-गुजरात का वैचारिक अंतर भारतीय स्वतंत्रता संग्राम में व्यापक क्रांतिकारी-गांधीवादी विभाजन से मेल खाता है।
• ऐतिहासिक कथाओं में 'नेतृत्व' का अर्थ प्रतीकात्मक मुखौटा हो सकता है न कि रणनीतिक कमांड, यह प्राथमिक स्रोत आधारित प्रश्नों के लिए एक उपयोगी आलोचनात्मक पठन कौशल है।
